d:
I went to India to tell the story of the country’s only female truck driver, and along the way, we got caught in multiple life-threatening landslides. This turned into one of the craziest adventures of my life, and it gave me so much respect for the people who brave these conditions every day in Himachal Pradesh. I’d love to hear your thoughts and opinions in the comments below.
Thank you to Garima for joining the trip and helping translate! Check out her travels here!
I wrote a book called JUST GO, with exclusive travel stories & tips to inspire your next adventures!
